summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Osisko Development Corp., a Canadian foreign private issuer, reporting a press release that announces exploration drilling results at its Cariboo Gold Project. The release highlights gold mineralization intercepts at depth and in gap zones, with assay grades such as 13.19 g/t Au over 3.60 m. There are no corporate transactions, structural changes, or special situations; it is a routine update on exploration progress.
